balls.text: Perfect finish for PBKS, three runs and three wickets off the final over! Low full toss... taken at long-on. Middle-stump ball, Bhuvi tried to drive over long-on. Like Krunal, got it a touch too low
Chipped to the left of long-on. He has to run in, Bhuvi happy with the single

Slot ball, but Krunal finds long-on! PBKS pulling it back bigtime. Attempted yorker was on middle and leg, Krunal showed all his stumps, gave the lofted on-drive all his power. Sliced it in the end, bat face opened on impact. Low-ish catch for Shreyas
Single it is. length on fourth, guided to point

Pinned in front of all three, given lbw. Shepherd reviews but continues to walk anyway. Was a yorker that landed on the crease, in front of middle, and hit low on the back leg. The front foot was well outside leg as he tried to lift it over square leg. Ball went under the bat, it's smashing middle and off according to Hawk-Eye's prediction.
Yorker angling in towards leg, worked to long-on
Slot ball, slugged with control! 20 rows over long-on. At the stumps, Shepherd didn't have to move. The pop from the crowd right after is as pure as the sound from ball hitting bat.

Some luck for Shepherd, fine leg came in and this goes one-bounce four behind him. Was a wide, short ball around head height, Shepherd opened his stance and tried to drag it with a pull. Got a lucky top edge
Shortish just over the stumps, pulled to deep midwicket
Shepherd slaps hard without going across, toes it to deep midwicket. Omarzai keeping the length out of his arc, close to the off-side tramline
Short over fifth, Krunal shaped to go across before standing put on leg. Slaps it to deep point
Short on fourth, pulled to deep midwicket
Fullish ball hits the bat hard, chips up despite Shepherd checking the shot. Goes towards mid-on
Back of length on middle, finds the leading edge. Pandya tried to work it leg side, got it through point. Didn't go through with his shot

Off bail's trimmed, Jitesh's cameo ends! Seam-up 134ks length ball lands on fourth, may have seamed in a touch. Jitesh tried to slog over long-on, edged it onto his back leg and it just kissed the stumps. Vyshak shapes to punch the air but holds himself back

Late appeal from the keeper for caught behind, given! Jitesh reviews instantly. Angled-bat dab to third attempted, ball's close to the sticker. Ultra-Edge shows there's nothing on it. Roar from the crowd.
Pulled into the ground this time, straight towards deep midwicket. Shepherd walked across to get inside the line of this
Should be out... isn't! Dubey sprints in from deep midwicket, got to it and tried to take it in front of him. Was a back of lengther around waist-height, Shepherd top edged the pull
Full around fourth at 135ks, driven to cover

They die down as Jamieson hits the back pad. That looked dead. Was a full toss that hit the back thigh, impact in front of middle and leg, hitting leg. A missed yorker, Livingstone stood firmly in front of leg stump and tried to pick it up behind square. Beaten on the inside edge.
Wide yorker missed and the crowd's elated! Big cheer as it goes near the return crease. Let go
Sits up and it's pulled over midwicket. Slower one again from Jamieson, got it around waist-height, Livingstone's still while hittling and slides right after. It goes 84 metres far

Another wide given on height, Livingstone grimaces but will have to accept the decision after the waster review. Was a short legcutter that went above the helmet. The batter made room early and tried to hook it behind the keeper
Makes room, yorker follows him, dinks it towards cover

Wasn't sure if he middled that but doesn't matter, sails high and well over long-off. Danced down late, got close-ish to the pitch of the ball, had room too, and he whacked it with a semi-horizontal bat

Bumper, Jitesh shapes for the reverse pull but lets it go due to height. Wide given, PBKS review. Looked high. Landed short on fourth stump, got spongy bounce. Yeah, way over. Head height's 1.84 metres, that went 2.2 metres
Jitesh might've one-upped SKY there, maybe upgrading the Dilscoop too. Got a length ball over off, he waited till the last second before collapsing and driving the bat from low to up.
Yorker on middle and leg, flicked to the right of midwicket and they scamper back for two. 133ks
Bouncer is slow off the pitch, pulled to deep fine leg from around neck height
Jitesh up and running. Makes room and slaps over cover point. Not that short, just over stump height. Jitesh able to free his arms

Gloved... beats the keeper! Jitesh wouldn't have wanted the pull to go that fine but will take it. Inglis jumped and got fingertips, left middle finger, on it but it was too far. Was a shortish ball at the chest that beat Jitesh for pace and by lack of room
Pulls the short ball to deep midwicket
Jitesh gets low, limboes and upper cuts the short ball to deep third
Fullish on fourth, might have swung in a bit, driven to mid-off

Kohli can't make up for the slow start! Omarzai runs three pitches over to midwicket and takes a sliding catch. He took it with both hands, grazed the ground and kept the ball in possession. Was a 127ks bumper at fifth stump, Kohli tried to pull it but it got big on him. Omarzai might've run his fingers across the ball there, might've spun in a bit. Hit the sticker of the bat
The oooo stops as Livingstone drives the full ball to long-off. Close to a yorker length, on middle
Bouncer over fourth stump is above head high, let go
Short ball rises around rib-height, 129ks, pulled to deep midwicket. PBKS, as Michael Clarke says, making Kohli hit it into the pockets. No front-foot shots on
Misses out on a slot ball. Inside edges it, would've been lbw otherwise. 139ks around middle, Livingstone wanted to slog that over midwicket, got it off the pads towards point
Livingstone takes a step outside off, so Omarzai goes for the wide yorker. It's landed outside the return crease but inside the cut strip. Let go.
Back of length around off, pulled to deep midwicket
Full on middle and leg, hittable but Kohli happy to push it to long-on. 90ks
Full on off, slides leg side and pushes to long-off
Length outside off, skiddier, tapped towards point
A bit late but Kohli joins in too. Slog sweeps between long-on and deep midwicket. Got a loopy length ball around off and he cleared the infielder with ease
Full on leg, worked to long-on

RCB kick into gear, proper risk this. Livingstone danced down early, Chahal likely saw him, went wide and full. The batter extended his arms and slashed to clear long-off. Chahal grimaces, unfortunately for him the legbreak didn't turn
Slow and full outside off, slapped hard and along the ground to long-off
Length on middle, 134ks, flicked to deep midwicket from the crease
Bouncer dug real far back, lobs well above head height. Went over middle stump, let go
Bouncer around head-height, good pace and bounce, Livingstone stays still and pulls to deep square leg
Well down leg. Went for the yorker, got it a touch too full. Keeper - Inglis - does well, covers some ground before diving full length to stop it.
Pulled to long-on from wide outside off again. Kohli chants go on as he runs, he's still coasting though
Fullish on fourth, driven to deep point
Pulled to long-on. Short ball looked slow, was well wide of off. Kohli jumped and reached out as he hit it
Wide on a length, cut to deep point
Tight two, Kohli ran along the pitch on the second. Livingstone dives to make it. Throw's a touch wide. Was a slightly short ball clipped off the back foot through midwicket
A bit of turn away and zip off the pitch. Landed fullish on off and finished fourth, cut to point
Defended again. Towards cover point for a quick single. Another stock ball from Chahal, who's giving it a bit of air. Fullish
Wow, this really is Kohli from a few years back - knocking it around. Flicks the full ball to long-on
Low fully on off, gets away with it as Livingstone eases a drive to long-on
Pitched up on fourth, driven to long-on

Jamieson celebrappeals with good reason. Pins Patidar in front with a 132ks yorker, it landed just in front of the crease but Paitdar didn't take a forward stride. Moved a touch towards off stump and tried to flick it off middle stump. Both feet were close, one in front of the other, so he couldn't maintain balance.
Back of lengther moves away off the pitch. Patidar made room and got beaten on the cut. 113ks, all four balls were legcutters
Pace on and it's lumped over mid-off. Read the slower one, got beside the line of the fullish ball. Drove with a stable base before sliding leg side
He's hooked a slower one with the bat going down to up. Vyshak charges to the right from deep fine, slides and turns to stop it. 112ks at the body from Patidar
Fullish ball's a touch too straight, Kohli doesn't attack though. Flicked to deep-backward square
Short of a good length ball just around off stump at 126kph, he pushes to mid-off
Back of a length ball on off stump, he works this towards deep square leg
Kohli's first aerial short of the innings and it comes via a ramp. Banged in short outside off at 133kph, he ramps this fine over past the keeper
Slower back of a length ball on the stumps, he pulls to dep backward square leg
Ooh, beaten. Offcutter that is banged in just outside off. Did that grip and turned into Patidar a touch? Surprise the speed gun showed 127 kph. Patidar looks to ramp this fine and misses
Banged in short outside off stump, he pulls to the right of long-on for a run
Legbreak well outside off stump, he goes back and across as he eases this to long-on
On a length on middle, he stays back and pushes to long-on
Off the front of the hand this time on a length on middle and leg, he heaves this to the right of deep backward square leg for two more
Patidar takes on Chahal and gets six! Slightly quicker legbreak on off and middle, he gets under it and sends it soaring over wide long-on
Tossed up legbreak well outside off, he stays back and punches to long-on
Excellent stop from Chahal. Short of a length outside off, he hammers this back to the left of the bowler, who dives and saves a run
Slower bouncer shoulder high outside off stump, Kohli swivels and pulls to deep backward square leg
Quick run. Slower good length ball around off stump, he tips this towards covers and sets off. Kohli will never shy away from those quick singles.
Short of a good length around the sixth stump, Virat punches this on the up and gets it to deep point
On a length on leg stump, he works this to deep backward square leg for a run
On a length just around off stump, he chops this close to the off stump
Oh, shot! Back of a length ball just outside off, he stays back and opens the face of the bat late to guide this fine to the right of deep third
Slows up the legbreak around middle stump, he works this towards midwicket. Just the six runs of the Chahal over.
Googly on middle and leg, he stays back and work this to deep square leg
Legspinner on a length outside off stump, he hops back and cuts this to the left of deep point for two
Flatter length ball on off, he eases this to long-on

Straight down the throat of deep backward square leg and Chahal takes two balls to strike. Marginally short on leg stump, Mayank stays deep in the crease, and looks to sweep this away. The extra bounce from Chahal does him in, though. Takes the top-edge and Arshdeep barely had to move.
Tossed up on the stumps, he pushes to long-on for a run
Sharp back of a length ball outside off, he slashes this to extra cover. RCB reach 55 for 1 after the powerplay.
Slower back of a length ball well outside off, he pulls to the left of deep midwicket and some excellent running from Kohli allows them two
Straight up, Arshdeep runs back but can't reach it and ends up kicking it to the boundary. Was a length ball in off, he miscues this straight up but gets enough bat to clear mid-off.
Back of a length ball just outside off, he lifts this over the cover fielder for a couple of runs

Oh, that's a good stop from Chahal. On a length on Kohli's pads, he clips this with some speed to Chahal who dives to his right and intercepts. Chahal is carrying an injury on that right hand, so that would have stung
Starts with a fullish length ball around off stump, he punches this to mid-off a bit too firmly
Decent start from Omarzai. Short of a length ball just outside off, he gets on top of the bounce and pulls to deep midwicket.
On a good length outside off, he stands tall and pushes this through covers for a couple of runs
Short and wide outside off, there was a hint of away shape on that. He carves this to deep point
Good length ball on middle and leg, he works this past short fine leg for a run
Fullish in length on middle stump, he looks to flick this away, can only manage to squirt it off the inside half of the blade towards square leg
On a length shaping away from Kohli outside off, he punches this on the up to deep cover
Finds the fielder. Was a length ball outside off, at 133kph he punches this on the up but can't get past the cover fielder
The extra bounce does Mayank in. Back of a length outside off stump at 136kph. Mayank looks to cut that fine, but can't get on top of the bounce and is beaten
Another play and a miss. Back of a length on off stump, he charges down the track looking to crash this through covers, but can't lay a bat on that
All timing and Mayank has started briskly. Good length ball well outside off, he stays back and caresses it so neatly past point.
Back of a length ball outside off, he chops this to backward point and sets off. A misfield from the fielder makes the run easier to complete.
Too straight and Kohli accepts the gift with glee.  Fuller and on his pads, there is no deep fine leg in place and that's an easy boundary for Kohli
Gets hold of it and there's a second six for RCB! Slower offcutter at 114kph, but right in Mayank's slot on off. He goes straight over the bowler's head and gets this six for his effort.
On a length on middle stump at 129kph, he works this to short midwicket
Banged in short, this time a touch too high. Called a wide. Slower short ball on middle and leg, but well over Mayank's head.
On a length just outside off, he pushes to mid-off and sets off quickly
Short and wide, he latches on to the cut but the fielder in the deep is in position as he moves swiftly to his left from deep cover
Ooh, another play and a miss! Short of a good length angling across the batter, who looks to run this fine and misses
Up and over, not off the middle but he gets two. Fullish in length outside off, the bat turns in his hands but he's got it over covers. Kohli wanted a third but is sent back
Edged but falls short of Arya at slip. On a good length shaping away from the batter, who pokes at it, gets a healthy edge but the catch was well short
Play and a miss! Back of a length ball shaping away from the batter who throws his bat at it but can't connect

Straight up and Shreyas has taken such an important catch back-peddling. On the fuller side out length nibbling away ever so late outside off at 127.7kph. Salt looks to go up and over, but gets it off the toe-end of the bat. The ball balloons straight up as Shreyas runs back, then back-pedals and hangs on
On a good length nipping back into Salt on middle and leg. He gets a thick inside edge onto pad
Salt's assault is on! On a length on the stumps, he gets this over mid-on. Not off the middle of the bat but the end result is what he'll worry about
And, he's away. Short of a good length ball well outside off, he gets across and guides to deep backward point
Another bouncer and a dot ball to end the opening over. Banged in short angling across Salt outside off. He sways away from the line of that
Four more and Salt and RCB are away, alright! Short of a length on leg stump, he swivels and pulls to the deep fine leg fence
On a length on middle and leg, he flicks this to the left of deep midwicket for a couple of runs
Matter of inches! Back of a length ball on Salt's hips down leg. He helps this juusst over a leaping deep fine leg. Salt gets RCB's six counter running.
Finds the fielder. Fuller in length just around off stump, he laces the cover drive but can't find the gap. Cover collects it
On a length shaping away from Salt just outside off, he mistimes towards mid-off.
Some movement but Arshdeep starts too straight and ends up misfiring the length ball down leg.  Called a wide and RCB are away

Clears the cover boundary but it's Patidar who's charging with a smile! Kohli has his head in the ground, he's thrilled when's back up. Has many of his team-mates hugging. The party won't end tonight!
Slot ball at the stumps, launched over midwicket. Shashank gets to fifty but it'll only be a consolation
Top-edged pull goes over the keeper. Goes to the fence but Krunal's applauding and roaring, smiles in their dugout too
Connects, too late though. Shashank shakes his head after flicking the low fully on middle over square leg
Slapped to long-off along the ground. Into mathematically-impossible territory now. And the crowd pops off, Kohli has his hands on his mouth. RCB's supporters in the stands can hardly believe it!
Gets away with a full toss! Fans go up again. Lowish full toss around leg, Shashank went across and that worked against him. Tried to help it along, missed it
Another perfect yorker, Bhuvi's nearly sealed this. Fourth-stump line, Shashank jams it on its head, towards the diagonal right of the keeper for a single
Low fully on leg, can't get underneath it. Flicked through square leg, they manage two
Spins away from Krunal at deep fine leg, he ran left, it went to his right late in the piece. Was a low full toss that was lapped
Another dot, nearly done now. Bhuvi goes yorker again, gets it on middle. Shashank is a touch too far across, drills it against the angle to long-off. No run
Reversing yorker lands perfectly and sears towards off. Shashank can only jam it to the off side
Bhuvi misses the yorker and gets tonked. Seam-up, lowish full toss on fourth. Launched through the line, over long-on
Yorker aimed at the pads. Not perfect but Jamieson doesn't get underneath, clips it to deep midwicket. They don't take a run!
Full toss, three-quarters of the way up the stumps. Whacked, but not off the middle, to deep square leg
Almost taken! Shepherd flies to the right from backward square leg, can only parry it off the right hand to the deep fielder. Was a shin-high full toss. Shashank got under it and tried to sweep
Full down leg, beats the flick. Goes off the pad towards square leg

Proper collapse on now! Taken at short third, the cheers from the crowd is wowing ABD. Was an 116ks cutter, full on fourth. Omarzai, with an open stance, tried to slug it over cow corner. Top edged it to short third. Bhandage, the sub fielder, takes it
Dayal confident that was lbw, not given. Went yorker on leg, landed just outside the line. Beat the leg glance, went off the pad towards fine leg
Overpitched on fourth, punched to long-off
Wide on a fullish length, driven to deep point

Six and out for Stoinis, he whacks the turf with his bat. The reach wasn't enough to scythe this wide yorker in the gap, found short third. Bread-basket catch for Dayal. Fielders and crowd are jubilant. Kohli turns to the AB de Villiers ,smiling outside the boundary, and pumps his fists.
Wow, he's caressed it but cleared the wide-long-off boundary with ease. First ball! Was a wide, full ball, uses long leavers and drives

Wadhera's misery ends, fans are ecstatic. Krunal's pumped too, takes the catch running in from deep cover and pumps his fists in delight. Was a full, wide 134ks ball. Close to the tramline. Wadhera had an open stance and then didn't get across, tried to reach out with his hands. Toed the lofted drive
Yorker on fourth, jammed down the pitch
Rare slot ball from Hazlewood, Shashank drives through the line. Gets it straight of long-on, 78 metres far. "Shot!" exclaims Shreyas. That did reverse but into the middle of the bat
Low fully on sixth, Wadhera drives from where he stands to deep cover
Almost gets bowled around the legs. Wadhera went across and tried to sweep the full ball, it went just outside leg

Leg-stump yorker beats the flick and goes off the shoe to deep fine leg. LBW was turned down, Hazlewood was interested and convinces Patidar to review. No bat involved. Hit the outer-edge of the front pad, might've reversed, impact umpire's call and missing leg. RCB are out of reviews.
Shashank is able to get inside the line and connect with the pull. Gets it super fine and over the boundary for a 64-metre six. Was an offcutter on leg around rib-height
Goes across for the ramp, gets followed by a yorker on the tramline. Not middled, gets it to short fine leg
Crowd's getting excited... no, dies down as it goes on the bounce to long-on. Hard-length, pace-on. Shashank goes across to get inside the line and pulls
Half-tracker is slow, Shashank goes across and pulls to deep midwicket. Kohli standing well inside the boundary there
Slower bouncer around head-height. A touch wide, Shashank takes a step across and cuts. Finds point on the bounce
Tries to pull it, gets hurried a touch. To midwicket it goes
Slogged off a length. Fourth-stump ball, just under stump height. Shepherd slinging it again, Wadhera's bat swinging from the direction of third over midwicket
Pulls the short ball to deep square leg
Overpitched, driven over the bowler. At the stumps too. Allows a step-hit
Suyash finishes well. PBKS keep trying to whack it but aren't finding the timing. Shashank cloths a flat-bat hit to a shortish ball on fourth to the left of the bowler. Half-stopped
Cut to deep point. On a length, fifth stump, skidding through
Another reverse beaten. Tries to hit it on the rise this time, the length ball on fourth goes straight through
Sharp throw from Krunal but they make it back. Was a slightly short ball on fourth, turned away, worked off the back foot
Beaten on the reverse sweep. Premeditated, went for it despite the full ball being wide, stood where he was and tried to reach out with his hands

Fired down leg, length ball. Goes past the flick, keeper half-stops it. Oh wait, RCB have reviewed. It's close to the left edge of the front pad. Just over the knee-roll. Ultra-Edge confirms a tickle. Review retained
Flat 94ks length ball on off, punched to the bowler's left. He parries it towards cover with a dive and looks down as to catch his breath. As of now, he's turned the game
Pulls it from a slightly short length to deep square leg
Fullish on fourth, spins away a bit and holds a touch, batter into the cover drive a touch too early. Ball hovers in the air before rolling to deep cover
Full on leg, blocked to the bowler
Fullish outside off, punched with the spin to cover

Krunal's winning it for RCB, he started the wicket flow and now has Inglis caught at the long-on boundary. He charges towards the fielder as RCB party. Livingstone, on the boundary, moved to the right and snaffled it over his right shoulder. Inglis tried to make the play by making room and dancing down early, got a 100ks fullish ball angling in, bat-face turned inwards. Inglis was jumping, trying to will it over the boundary. Can't
Goes for the ramp despite the deep fielder in position for it. Edges the bouncer to deep third
Another teasing six over deep midwicket for Inglis. Read the slower short ball early, sprung up and pulled it off rib-height. Livingstone goes to he his diagonal right but it sails over him
Fullish on off, clipped to deep midwicket who runs in
Length on fifth, skiddy, might've been slow. No, 137ks. Cut to cover
Wide full toss lands on the grass but it's after the pitch. Let go.
Hard length on fourth, Wadhera inside edges an attempted punch to cover. Finds midwicket
Slings a yorker from an 11'o clock angle on the base of middle, clipped to deep square leg
Krunal runs to the left to cut the single, another cheer. Was a length ball on fourth that was flicked off the back foot
Full on middle, worked back to the bowler. More cheers from the crowd
Lbw appeal but that might've landed down leg. Length ball on the pads, Wadhera tried to paddle it while standing upright.
Makes room and cuts the 92ks length ball around leg to deep point
Shortish and fired in on a back of length. Leg-stump line. Beats the flick and hits thigh pad
Short, and that's pulled for another flat six over midwicket. Top-of-stump height, Inglis crouches which staying in the crease and swivels late
Slower short of a length ball outside off, he dabs this fine to deep third
Sharp short of a length ball on middle stump. He gets this around rib-high and works this behind square

That's a body blow! Iyer has gone for 1 and RCB are right on top. That was almost a nothing delivery. Good length ball scrambled seam well outside off at 137kph. Shreyas plays a lazy cut, gets a thick edge and Jitesh has taken the simplest of catches. No Shreyas magic tonight and my word, there is bedlam in Ahmedabad at the moment.
Slower back of a length ball on off and middle, he gets across and pulls this to the left of deep square leg
On-pace good length ball well outside off, he mistimes his slap towards cover
Slower offcutter back of a length on off stump, he pulls and thrashes this to the vacant deep midwicket fence
On the fuller side on leg stump, he ticks this to the left of Dayal at short fine leg. Was looking for a second, but Dayal gets rid of the ball quickly
Angled in on off and middle, he backs away looking to lace this through covers, gets a thick inside edge back towards the bowler
Tossed up on a length just around off stump, he pushes this to deep cover

The pressure gets the better of Prabhsimran and RCB have another opening. Slower through the air at 80.9kph on middle stump, getting it to turn away late. Prabhsimran charges down, does not reach the pitch as he attempts a wild hoick across the line. Gets a big top edge and Bhuvneshwar at point takes a simple catch
Mistimed pull to deep midwicket. Was dragged down just around off stump, he pulls not off the middle
Marginally short just on off, Prabhsimran works this to deep midwicket for a run
Wrong'un on a length on middle and leg, he works this to the on-side and sets off for a quick run
He finally gets one away. Fuller and right in Prabhsimran's slot on middle stump. He backs away and thumps this straight over the bowler's head
Short and wide, cuts it hard and straight to point
Darted on off stump, he was looking to pulls it again but the ball comes on quickly and he can only splice it to long-on
PUMPED for a six over deep midwicket. Dragged down on the stumps, he rocks back and deposits it way over Kohli's head
And almost gets a wicket with it first ball. Tossed up wrong'un on off, he looks to flay it across the line, gets a thick inside-edge behind square
Low full toss well outside off, he pushes this to deep point
Fuller and down leg, he gets right across his off stump looking for a scoop fine and misses. The umpire does not call that a wide
Angles this length ball slower and on middle stump. He eases this to long-on
Bowls this quicker and on a length on leg stump, he was looking to flick this away, gets a thick inside-edge onto pad
Flatter length ball on off stump, he works this to deep midwicket for a run
Dated in on the shorter side just on off, he tips this to point
PBKS get 52 in the powerplay, RCB had got 55. Who's in front? A length ball on off stump, Inglis defends this to the on-side
Pulled with disdain and gets six. Banged in short around waist high on leg stump, he pulls this handsomely over the deep square leg fence

Attempts the scoop which does not come off. Jitesh is saying, there is a sound. Dayal also felt there was something on it. Patidar has reviewed. I don't think Inglis is anywhere near it. Yep, not out is the verdict from the third ump. Back of a length ball outside off, he gets right across and looks for a scoop, but misses
Good length ball on leg stump, he works this to midwicket
Inglis gets going right away. Back of a length ball on his hips, he helps this to deep square leg region for a couple of runs
On a length on middle stump, he works this to long leg for a run

There's the wicket RCB have been searching for and Salt has produced a moment of absolute brilliance to get that. Back of a length ball on middle stump at 141kph. Arya picks this up towards the deep square leg fence. Salt, who is stationed behind square, hares to his right at speed, takes the catch reverse-cupped, throws the ball up in the air as he loses balance and goes over the ropes. Then comes back into the field of play to complete it. Exemplary! And the reaction from the RCB fielders shows how much that wicket means to them
Gets the yorker to tail back into Prabhsimran around middle stump. He digs this towards mid-on and takes another run
Good length ball on the stumps, he works this to midwicket and sets off

Two in two! Backs away one more time and Hazlewood follows him again with a short of a length ball outside leg. He once again swings at it, and once again slices this in between the keeper and short third

Sliced over short third. Not where he was wanting to go, but the result is all that matters. He backs away big time but Hazlewood follows him cramping him for room with a a bouncer. He ends up slicing this
On a length angling across Arya outside off, he pushes to Kohli at backward point and they are not going a risk a single to him
Full and way down leg stump, called a wide
Just short of a good length around off stump, he pushes this to extra cover
Length ball on Arya's pad, he flicks this to deep midwicket
On a length outside off, he creams a cover drive on the up but straight to cover

Did Bhuvneshwar get a hand to it? That would be so unlucky if Prabhsimran is run out at the non-striker's end. Oh, scratch all of that. Prabhsimran is inside his crease. Well done. Length ball on middle, Arya presents the full face of the bat and punches this back towards the bowler. Bhuvneshwar gets a finger on it as the ball crashes into the non-striker's stumps. But Prabhsimran was well in
On a length with a hint of nibble away from Prabhsimran outside off, he pushes towards point and takes quick run
Back of a length ball outside off, Prabhsimran crashes this to the left of mid-off. Hazlewood sprints behind it and keeps the ball in with a dive.

Up in the air and falls in no-man's land. The rub of the green so far going PBKS' way. Was a back of a length ball on middle stump. Arya attempts a short arm jab but the ball catches his top edge and balloons straight up. There was  no one at deep square
Good length ball angling across Arya outside off, pushed to point

Put down by Romario Shepherd at deep backward square leg. Oh, my word!  These have to be taken. Back of a length ball on his hips on leg stump. He pulls this flat and with some speed. Shepherd watches this all the way, but shells it. It came to him around waist high, and really that should have been held
Tip and run, again. Good length ball angling across Arya who plays with a slight open face of the bat towards point
Quick single. Short of a good length just around off stump, he dabs this late towards point and sets off. Arya responds
Lands the ball on a length shaping into Prabhsimran on middle and leg. He clips this to short midwicket
Leg-byes and four. They all count and PBKS are away to a bit of a flier. Length ball down leg, he misses the clip but the ball his pad and runs away to the vacant fine leg fence
Angles the good length ball across Prabhsimran outside off stump, he goes back and across and guides this to the right of short third
On a length angling away from Prabhsimran just around off stump. He plays with a slight open face of the bat to point
Fullish in length just around off stump, he opens the face of the bat and glides this to the right of Krunal at backward point who does well
Sliced past short third! Back of a length ball well outside off. They width was the key as Arya throws his hands at it and beats short third
On a length outside off stump, he punches this on the up but can't beat cover

In the aiiiiiir and just over a leaping Salt at deep third. Oof, Prabhsimran's heart would have been in his mouth. Short of a length ball outside off, he carves this up and over and Salt despite that leap can't keep that inside the field of play
Length ball on middle and leg stump, Arya works this to deep backward square leg
In the air but goes to Hazlewood on the bounce. Length ball outside off, he pushes this on the up to mid-off. Was aerial for quite a bit
Short of a good length ball just outside off, he he pats this to the right of short third who dives and keeps them down to a run
On a length on Arya's pads, he works this to deep midwicket
PBKS and Arya are away with a four. Loosener and that is dealt with. On a length down leg, he nudges this fine to the vacant fine leg fence
